blocks.text: The module documentation describes network isolation, request parsing limits, address refusal, DNS pinning, relay limits, and the intentional limits of a destination-only proxy.
blocks.title: Proxy threat model

blocks.text: NetworkError carries a short code. _blocked and blocked_address reject private, local, reserved, mapped, NAT64, and malformed addresses; fixed HTTP responses are generated without request content.
blocks.title: Address safety and fixed responses

blocks.text: ProxyConfig defines request, DNS, connection, idle, and concurrency caps. Resolver/connector defaults operate on addresses, while make_private_dir creates a short, mode-0700 directory.
blocks.title: Configuration and private socket directory

blocks.text: ProxyServer initializes policy and transport collaborators, writes the bridge script, opens a Unix listener, and closes tasks, writers, listener, and directory during shutdown.
blocks.title: Proxy lifecycle

blocks.anchor: async def _handle(self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
blocks.text: Each connection is counted and parsed under limits, then checked against policy and per-host capacity. Approved traffic opens one upstream, sends the CONNECT response or original cleartext head, and relays; refusals use fixed responses.
blocks.title: Connection admission

blocks.anchor: async def _read_head(self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
blocks.text: Request parsing enforces ASCII HTTP syntax and authority ports. _open_upstream resolves names once, rejects any unsafe answer, and tries bounded approved addresses without resolving again.
blocks.title: Parsing and pinned upstream

blocks.anchor: async def _splice(self, c_reader: asyncio.StreamReader, c_writer: asyncio.StreamWriter,
blocks.text: _splice runs two bounded pipes, resets shared activity time on data, terminates on idle or EOF, and cleans up both tasks and half-closes where possible.
blocks.title: Bidirectional relay

blocks.text: NetworkService owns a ProxyServer on a dedicated event loop thread, exposes readiness and lifecycle state, mounts the private directory, forwards coroutines to the loop, and reports safe copies of stats.
blocks.title: Background-thread service

blocks.text: make_service builds the production policy and service without exposing the test loopback flag. service_for reuses or replaces services by owner and settings key; cleanup helpers stop services without raising.
blocks.title: Per-owner service registry

gotchas: Headers and tunneled payloads are not inspected.
The loopback relaxation is test-only and constructor-only.
Cleartext is disabled by default; allowed domains can still receive arbitrary bytes.
how_it_works: Pins and connects to an approved address
Relays bytes with idle and concurrency limits
purpose: The proxy accepts Unix-socket traffic from a network-isolated sandbox and decides whether to open an outbound tunnel. It validates CONNECT requests, applies policy and address blocking, resolves once before connecting, enforces connection and idle limits, and offers a thread-backed service wrapper for synchronous callers.
summary: Runs the host-side, policy-controlled network proxy used by sandboxed commands.
